Porter’s reputation as one of americanca’s most distinguished writers rests chiefly on her superb short stories.
This volume includes the collections Flowering Judas; Pale Horse, Pale Rider; and The Leaning Tower as well as four stories not available elsewhere in book form.

Winner of the National Book Award and the Pulitzer Prize.
